sources.title: Statoids — Districts of Kenya, change history (Gwillim Law)
sources.says: Lists Kenya's 40 districts on 1966-07-31 with their provinces; later districts were split inside provinces (one Turkana→West Pokot transfer within Rift Valley).

sources.title: Statoids — Counties of Kenya, change history (Gwillim Law)
sources.says: 1963: North-Eastern formed from Northern and part of Coast; table of the eight provinces (incl. Nairobi Area); 2013 reorganized into 47 counties.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Provinces of Kenya (rev 1334399350)
sources.says: The eight provinces were replaced by 47 counties in 2013 following the general elections of 4 March 2013.

spans.dateNote: From independence (regions of the 1963 constitution, renamed provinces later). Ends on the 2013-03-04 general election, from which the 2010 constitution's devolved counties took effect (statoids gives 2013-03-27).
